A real explicit pending publish remains QUEUED whenever sync-outbox still contains work.
Normal Safari and fresh browser contexts converge to the same published presentation for the same canonical state.
non_goals: No outbox ordering or pruning semantic change.
No Customer, Owner, SMM or SMT changes.
